name: planning-with-files

description.en: Persistent file-based planning for AI coding agents and long-running tasks. Crash-proof markdown plans, session recovery after /clear and compaction, per-turn re-injection against context rot, deterministic completion gate. Manus-style. Install from npm, the Claude Code plugin marketplace, or npx sk
description.zh: 基于文件的持久化规划，支持崩溃恢复和上下文防丢失。
